title: Make small controls at least 44px to tap (theme toggle, calendar arrows, close X, select and menu rows, switches, tabs, score buttons)
request: please fix everything that comes up, dont just wait until you are done with a task to ask me if you can fix (the audit found controls smaller than the 44px tap size this app uses for buttons)

criteria.text: Theme toggle (header, every page): at least 44px wide and tall; before: 42px wide
criteria.evidence: Header theme toggle: box 42x44 on every admin page before -> 44x44 (absent from the after-scan; scanner row 'Toggle theme' was in 11 states). Test pin fails on the old code. Evidence: .factory/evidence/T-261106-make-small-controls-at-l/before/taps.json and scratchpad ev-t/after/taps.json.

criteria.text: Calendar Previous and Next Month arrows: at least 44px wide; before: 28px wide (day cells stay 36px wide on purpose so seven fit a 320px phone, and are 44px tall)
criteria.evidence: Calendar Previous/Next Month arrows: box 28x44 -> 44x44 in the Batch Matches, Timeslots and Auto Schedule pickers and in the schedule page calendar (it had its own copy of the classes). Day cells stay 36px wide on purpose (7 must fit a 320px phone) and 44px tall. Tests fail on the old code.

criteria.text: Dialog close X: a tap area of at least 44px with the same look (and the season form Close button 44px wide); before: 16px and 40px
criteria.evidence: Dialog close X: 16x16 (tap 16x16) in the Requests, Teams and Divisions dialogs before -> not in the after-scan (tap area 44x44 via hit-area-44). Season form Close button 40x44 -> 44x44. Tests fail on the old code.

criteria.text: Select triggers are 44px tall like text fields; before: 40px. Select options and user-menu items are at least 44px tall on touch screens (desktop rows unchanged); before: 36px
criteria.evidence: Select boxes 40px (and 24, 32, 36, 40px where five callers set their own height) -> 44px at 390, 768 and 1280. Option rows and user-menu items 36px -> 44px on touch (matchMedia pointer: coarse; rows measured 44, 44, 44 at 390x844) while a mouse keeps 36px at 768 and 1280. Tests fail on the old code.

criteria.text: Tabs: tap area at least 44px tall with the same look; before: 42px
criteria.evidence: Tab triggers 42px -> 44px tall (Teams page tabs 126x42 -> 126x44, Auto Schedule 116x42 -> 116x44) at 1280 and 768px; the tab bar is 2px taller, as a Button is. Test fails on the old code.

criteria.text: Switches (Double Header, Batch Match, Avoid rematches and others): tap area of at least 44px tall with the same look, except where two switches are closer than 44px (the two stacked Auto Schedule switches share the gap, 36px and 44px); before: 24px
criteria.evidence: Switches keep their 44x24 look and get an invisible 44px area (hit-area-44 in the shared Switch). After-scan: tap 44x44 where there is room; the two stacked Auto Schedule switches share the 36px gap between them (36px and 44px), which is why the criterion has that exception. Test fails on the old code.

criteria.text: Remove and icon-only buttons in the small sizes (Remove match pair, Remove signup, hero card remove, reaction pickers, close buttons): at least 44px wide; before: 40px and 32px
criteria.evidence: Remove match pair 40px -> 44px wide (absent from the after-scan). Remove signup (size-8 p-0), hero card remove buttons (size-8), reaction pickers and close buttons: min-w-[44px] on the small Button sizes and DestructiveIconButton. Remove signup, hero remove and reaction pickers are pinned by tests that fail on the old code but were not opened in the browser (INFERRED for their box size: min-width beats width).

criteria.text: Admin Scores result buttons (2–0, 2–1, 1–2, 0–2) are at least 44px wide on every phone; before: 38.5px wide at 320px
criteria.evidence: Admin Scores result buttons: 38.5px wide at 320px -> 83px wide in two rows of two; at 342px and up four buttons of 44px or more in one row (sweep 320, 330, 340, 341: 83, 88, 93, 93.5px; 342: 44px; 360: 48.5px). Test fails on the old code.

criteria.text: No invisible tap area covers the centre of another control on the audited screens; nothing else moves (same text and layout at 768 and 1280px, no new console errors, no sideways scroll); existing tests pass and each new test fails on the old code

Text fields that set their own small height (admin sidebar search, weekly-content blurb boxes, History rename and add-division boxes, division edit fields, hero editor fields) are the standard 44px; before: 32 to 40px
criteria.evidence: Fields with their own small height: sidebar search 32px, blurb boxes 32px, History rename and add-division boxes 36px, division edit fields 36 and 40px, hero editor fields 32px -> 44px (measured on Divisions 36 -> 44 at 1280 and 768px). The playoffs season picker is 44px on touch and 40px only with a mouse from md up. Five tests fail on the old code.

criteria.text: Other small controls: checkboxes, contact email links, the hero card name and colour swatch buttons, and the schedule page calendar arrows have a tap area of at least 44px; before: 16px, 15px, 40px and 32px, and 28px
criteria.evidence: Checkboxes (16px), contact email links (15px tall), the hero card name button (40px tall) and colour swatch button (32px), and the schedule page calendar arrows (28px wide) now have a 44px tap area (hit-area-44, min-w-[44px]). Contact link, hero buttons, checkbox and arrows are pinned by tests that fail on the old code.

reviews.summary: Plan review: classes VERIFIED. Taken: success metric is the effective tap size, not the box, for invisible areas; tabs become min-h-[44px] (wrapped tab rows touch, so an invisible area cannot grow); dialog X may reuse hit-area-44; the small Button sizes get min-w-[44px] (one place fixes ~10 icon buttons; default size left alone for calendar day cells); extra controls found: SeasonForm Close, Checkbox, hero swatch and name triggers, schedule header arrows, contact links, division and other fields with their own h-8/h-9/h-10, ReactionPicker. Scan also at 320 and overlap test.

notes.text: Criteria 3, 6, 7 reworded by hand (and criteria 10, 11 added) after the plan review: the review found more small controls than the first plan listed, and that stacked switches closer than 44px cannot both have a 44px area. Plan review recorded CHANGES; all notes taken.
